engineering_note.title: The projection source assumed everyone still has a team
engineering_note.body: A trade candidate's rest-of-season projection looked strong until a cross-check against the league's real constitution turned up a rule: stats only accrue when a player is on an NL club's active roster. The player in question had actually become a real-life free agent, no MLB team at all, but the projection source did not know that and kept forecasting a full season off stale pre-release data.
